lane_definition: Same-release Planck PR3 control: SMICA R3.00 maps + PR3 common masks + FFP10 (dx12_v3) SMICA CMB and noise simulations. It is a separate release from PR4/NPIPE and is never a PR4 null. No observed map was analysed.

inputs_source_bound.input_hash_result: 120 of 120 files: sha256 computed from local bytes in this session and equal to the earlier session's SHA256SUMS entry
inputs_source_bound.ffp10_random_sample_check: 24 of 24 randomly drawn files (seed 20261110, 12 cmb + 12 noise, outside indices 0-59) also matched the earlier list; the remaining 1155 files of the 1299 are not re-hashed
inputs_source_bound.fits_header_facts: PR3 maps/masks: nside 2048, NESTED, Galactic, K_CMB. FFP10 sims: nside 2048, RING, K_CMB, no COORDSYS keyword.

operator.steps: nside 2048 -> 16 mean-degrade; mask keeps pixels with >=90% unmasked children (f_sky 0.716); monopole+dipole fitted as nuisance; ordinary least squares on 5 Cartesian-STF Bianchi-I basis maps; B* reported in the Gram metric
operator.frame_assumption: FFP10 simulations assumed Galactic (no header keyword); a wrong assumption would misalign the mask relative to scan-pattern-correlated noise

results_synthetic.null_interpretation: all five component means within 1.32 standard errors of zero for 60 sims; consistent with no estimator bias at this precision. The sample sd itself carries about 9% uncertainty (N=60). No coverage/SBC was run.
results_synthetic.injection_interpretation: Noise-free: measures response/leakage only. Linear-template recovery of the exact nonlinear map has relative error 1.7e-3 at B~1e-2 and 1e-5..3e-4 for B~1e-4..1e-3. The mask roughly triples the nonlinear leakage versus full sky at 1e-2. Nothing here is a detection or a sensitivity forecast.

claims.claim: A masked-sky linear-template Bianchi-I pipeline runs end to end on same-release PR3 simulations and recovers an injected exact-map signal with the response errors above.
Null estimator scatter for B* in the Gram norm is about 2.2e-5 at nside 16, f_sky 0.716.
claims.limit: N=60; OLS not optimal; no beam
PR3 beam/RIMO files were queued 2026-11-10 but their mapping to the SMICA product was not read

not_run: real SMICA map analysis (deliberately not done)
